# EdLight Initiative

> EdLight Initiative makes quality education free and accessible to students in Haiti. It is a registered Canadian not-for-profit corporation (no. 1376443-5), based in Montreal, Quebec, and has run programmes for Haitian students since 2020.

We run free online courses in the subjects Haitian students sit national exams in, a coding platform taught in Haitian Creole, French, and English, free Coursera access with certificates for selected students, and a two-week summer leadership programme. The site is available in English and French.

## Programmes

- [EdLight Academy](https://www.edlight.org/academy): free courses and practice for the 9e Année and Baccalauréat exams. The platform itself is at https://academy.edlight.org
- [EdLight Code](https://www.edlight.org/code): hands-on coding tracks taught in Haitian Creole, French, and English. The platform itself is at https://code.edlight.org
- [EdLight Scholars](https://www.edlight.org/coursera-scholars): free Coursera access with certificates for selected students and partner institutions
- [EdLight Summer Leadership Program (ESLP)](https://www.edlight.org/eslp): a two-week summer leadership programme for secondary students

## Applying

- [EdLight Apply](https://apply.edlight.org): applications for ESLP, EdLight Scholars and other opportunities
